messages:
trina: dropped a quick design pass for model catalog compare. main asks: clearer pin semantics, better perf badge contrast, and compact filter chip behavior. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/unique/model-catalog-ux

omar: saw it. on pin semantics users conflate pin with favorite. propose 'Lock version for route' as primary label + helper line 'Overrides rollout rules'. two-line tooltip seems to reduce ambiguity in tests.

yuki: agree on two-line. also suggest microcopy for the pin action: button label stays short 'Lock' and tooltip explains routing effect. avoids long inline labels.

matt: perf badge note: current color values fail at small sizes. propose tokens --perf-good:#15803d, --perf-ok:#d97706, --perf-bad:#b91c1c. include aria-label like 'p95 latency 180ms' and a visually-hidden span for screen readers.

omar: filter chips: show up to 3 tiny overlapping avatars for comments, collapse to '+N' under 360px. ensure chip is a single button with aria-pressed and avatars aria-hidden when decorative.

yuki: for compare header, implement sticky header inside the horizontal scroll container. beware of shadow clipping; add z-index shim when sticky. keyboard nav must preserve focus order when header becomes sticky.
	rina: empty state microcopy: current 'No models selected' -> proposed 'No models  pick or lock a version to compare.' keeps it active.
matt: accessibility checklist for PR: 1) aria-pressed on chips 2) aria-labels for perf badges 3) focus trap for popovers 4) toast with aria-live polite on lock action 5) color contrast sweep.
omar: i'll prototype CSS for avatars and sticky header. matt, i'll coordinate contrast sweep with you.
yuki: let's A/B test label styles: variant A button='Lock' tooltip='Overrides rollout' variant B button='Pin' tooltip='Keeps version fixed for route'. 5% traffic each.	rina: timeline: sign-off by tomorrow noon, dev prototype by Thu, ship behind flag next week. posting final figma frames when updated. thanks all :sparkles:
